name: Table CSV Encoding
changes: The Pro notice for folder table export in Table CSV Encoding now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Turn on the BOM option when a spreadsheet app needs a clear UTF-8 signal. The CSV file then starts with the bytes EF BB BF.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table CSV Encoding is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
